description: CrossTL frontend language surface snapshot for CrossGL-Compiler shared language spec integration.

extraction.method: live module constants/classes plus bounded static extraction of Parser.parse_type resource literals and AST constructor public field assignments

fields.name: vtype
fields.initializer: f"{element_type}[]" if size is None else f"{element_type}[{size}]"

notes: This v0 artifact snapshots CrossTL lexical/type/resource/stage facts.
It is not yet a full grammar or semantic spec.
Compiler-only strictness must be represented as later shared spec deltas.
